FR-001.title: The product MUST provide a persistent sidebar on the GNOME desktop.

FR-002.title: The user MUST be able to place the sidebar on the left or right and set its width.

FR-003.title: The sidebar MUST remain visible across workspace changes.

FR-004.title: The user MUST be able to hide the sidebar temporarily and restore it.

FR-005.title: The product MUST restore the sidebar configuration across desktop sessions.

FR-006.title: The sidebar MUST NOT block interaction with the desktop outside its bounds.

FR-007.title: The sidebar MUST NOT be drawn over the lock or login screens.

FR-008.title: The sidebar MUST show today's virtue: the one chosen in today's morning practice, or else the daily pick from bundled content.

FR-009.title: The sidebar MUST show today's passage: the daily pick for the date, or, once a virtue is chosen in morning practice, a passage associated with that virtue. The same date and virtue always give the same passage.

FR-010.title: The sidebar MUST show a concise Stoic reminder.

FR-011.title: The sidebar MUST give direct access to The Pause.

FR-012.title: The sidebar MUST show two practice indicators, Morning and Evening, each as Not started, In progress or Completed, with no percentage or score.

FR-013.title: Content MUST stay static unless the user changes it or an intentional daily update occurs; it MUST NOT rotate or animate.

FR-014.title: The user MUST be able to turn Meeting mode on and off manually. It MUST change only the Stoic Reminder section, to a meeting reminder, and MUST start off in every new desktop session.

FR-015.title: The product MUST guide a morning practice covering virtue, challenges, control, a passage and an intention.

FR-016.title: The product MUST guide an evening reflection covering what went well, disturbance, virtue and improvement.

FR-017.title: Every practice question MUST be optional.

FR-018.title: The product MUST NOT show scores, streaks or penalties.

FR-019.title: Practice answers MUST be saved locally as they are entered, and a practice MUST be marked complete only when the user explicitly finishes it.

FR-020.title: The product MUST offer Quick Reset and Deep Reflection.

FR-021.title: The user MUST be able to categorise the disturbance and optionally add free text.

FR-022.title: The product MUST give contextual Stoic guidance for each category.

FR-023.title: Guidance MUST NOT present itself as diagnosis or therapy.

FR-024.title: The flow MUST guide the user through judgement, control, virtue and response.

FR-025.title: A Pause session that is abandoned or completed without saving MUST leave no personal record. Only a saved session creates a journal entry. This applies to both Quick Reset and Deep Reflection.

FR-026.title: The product MUST provide a searchable Stoic library of Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus and Seneca, organised by author, work and theme.

FR-027.title: Each passage MUST include attribution, source, explanation, practical interpretation and a reflective question.

FR-028.title: Each passage MUST be labelled as a direct quotation, paraphrase or modern interpretation.

FR-029.title: The user MUST be able to save passages.

FR-030.title: The product MUST provide situational exercises.

FR-031.title: Morning intentions, evening reflections and saved Pause sessions MUST be stored locally as journal entries.

FR-032.title: The user MUST be able to browse, filter, edit, delete and export journal entries.

FR-033.title: Any pattern observations MUST be worded as suggestions, not conclusions.

FR-034.title: The user MUST be able to configure sidebar position and dimensions.

FR-035.title: The user MUST be able to configure appearance and background opacity.

FR-036.title: The user MUST be able to configure keyboard shortcuts, including one to toggle Meeting mode.

FR-037.title: The user MUST be able to configure daily reminders.

FR-038.title: The user MUST be able to configure Meeting mode behaviour.

FR-039.title: Personal information MUST be stored locally only, readable and writable by the owning user alone. It is not separately encrypted.

FR-040.title: Every feature MUST work without internet access.

FR-041.title: The product MUST NOT collect or transmit personal usage information, journal content or behavioural analytics.

FR-042.title: An interrupted activity MUST NOT corrupt existing records.

FR-043.title: The user MUST be able to permanently delete all personal data.

FR-044.title: The product MUST NOT use the microphone or camera, monitor desktop activity, or infer emotion automatically.

FR-045.title: Notifications MUST NOT contain journal content.

FR-046.title: Personal data MUST be kept separate from bundled philosophical content.

FR-047.title: The sidebar and all screens MUST be fully usable by keyboard.

FR-048.title: Every control MUST have an accessible name and a logical focus order, all screens MUST be usable with a screen reader, and text MUST follow the desktop text-scaling setting.

FR-049.title: The product MUST follow GNOME visual conventions and avoid unsupported or deprecated GNOME interfaces.

FR-050.title: Disabling the extension MUST release everything it created.

FR-051.title: The product MUST support GNOME Shell 50.x and 51.x, and the supported versions MUST be documented.

FR-052.title: AI-assisted features MUST be off by default, opt-in, clearly marked as suggestions, and MUST NOT replace user judgement.

FR-055.title: The sidebar MUST hide while a full-screen window is in front on its monitor, and return when it is not.

FR-053.title: Activating Daily Practice Status MUST open morning practice before noon and evening reflection from noon, and the user MUST be able to switch to the other practice.

FR-054.title: Evening reflection MUST show today's morning intention when one exists, and the user MUST be able to reopen and read any journal entry saved today.

FR-056.title: Guidance MUST treat emotions as natural, never as failure, and MUST NOT encourage suppressing emotion or condemning oneself for feeling it.

FR-057.title: Every step of The Pause MUST be skippable, so the user can go straight to choosing a response.

FR-058.title: Each bundled passage MUST record its author, work, translation, translator, edition and the basis for its public-domain status.

FR-059.title: Each bundled passage MUST be associated with at least one virtue, and each virtue MUST have at least one passage.

decisions.decision: Sidebar is a Shell chrome actor (addChrome, affectsStruts false, trackFullscreen true) on the primary monitor work area; user hide via removeChrome
decisions.why: Input only within bounds, visible on all workspaces, full-screen hiding for free, matches overlay default

decisions.decision: Morning, evening, Quick Reset and Deep Reflection run in one in-Shell ModalDialog driven by data flow definitions
decisions.why: Instant open from the sidebar, keyboard focus and Escape for free, one writer, one component instead of four
decisions.rejected: Separate GTK4/libadwaita companion app (second process, IPC, second writer)

decisions.decision: Journal is one JSON file per local date under XDG_DATA_HOME/stoic-companion/days, 0700/0600, atomic replace, debounced 500 ms, sync flush on disable
decisions.why: Atomic rename keeps old-or-new on crash (FR-042), small writes, fits today-only scope, no extra deps
decisions.rejected: SQLite (no binding guaranteed in Shell), append-only log

decisions.decision: Only the Shell process touches personal data; delete-all lives in the top-bar menu
decisions.why: Single writer avoids prefs/shell races on delete (SC-009)
decisions.rejected: Delete button in prefs with D-Bus or GSettings signalling

decisions.decision: Daily pick and passage are pure functions of date and virtue via FNV-1a over id-sorted content
decisions.why: Deterministic, no stored state, same date+virtue gives same passage (FR-009)
decisions.rejected: Stored random daily pick; day-of-year modulo

decisions.decision: One GnomeDesktop.WallClock minute signal drives midnight rollover and reminders
decisions.why: Follows suspend and timezone changes; monotonic GLib timeouts miss midnight after sleep
decisions.rejected: Timeout armed for next midnight plus logind resume hook

decisions.decision: Meeting mode is a field on the Extension instance
decisions.why: Survives lock (disable/enable) but resets in every new Shell process, matching FR-014
decisions.rejected: GSettings key reset at enable (would reset on every unlock)

decisions.decision: Content quotes only worldwide-public-domain translations: George Long (Aurelius 1862, Epictetus 1877), Aubrey Stewart (Seneca Minor Dialogues 1889)
decisions.why: Global distribution needs worldwide PD; FR-058 basis recorded per source
decisions.rejected: Gummere Loeb Letters (copyright in life+70 countries until 2040)

decisions.decision: Tests run under gjs with a ~40-line in-repo runner (make test)
decisions.why: Same runtime and Gio as production so store tests hit real atomic writes; nothing to install
decisions.rejected: jasmine-gjs (AUR install), Node test runner (cannot load gi:// modules)

decisions.decision: Test assert helpers live in tests/assert.js, re-exported by run.js
decisions.why: A test importing the entry module deadlocks on its top-level await
Four story test files need the same temp-dir store and content loading
decisions.rejected: Copying the helpers into each file

decisions.decision: Zip carries the schema XML; gnome-extensions install compiles it
decisions.why: Shell 44+ pack and install handle compilation; confirmed on a scratch install

decisions.decision: Option buttons in FlowDialog get an explicit wrapping St.Label child; dialogs never fade
decisions.why: In Shell 51 a labelled St.Button child has no clutter_text, and FR-013 forbids animation

approach: A GJS GNOME Shell extension whose sidebar is a chrome actor rendered from one derived TodayView. The four guided flows run in one data-driven ModalDialog. Personal data is per-day JSON written atomically by the Shell process alone, and configuration is in GSettings. Pure logic in lib/ is unit-tested under gjs, and Shell UI is checked by hand in a nested Shell on 50 and 51.
